summary: SOLAI Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing a planned ADS ratio change, effective about July 6, 2026, altering the ratio from 1 ADS : 100 Class A ordinary shares to 1 ADS : 700 Class A ordinary shares, equivalent to a one-for-seven reverse share split. The change affects only ADSs; no underlying ordinary shares are issued or cancelled. The trading symbol stays SLAI. No fractional new ADSs will be issued. The company warns that the expected proportional increase in ADS trading price is not guaranteed. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation. What to watch: actual post-change trading price compared to pre-change level.
